payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including macro F1-score increases and specific percentage improvements in relation classification.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent for implicit relation classification.
Compared to the baseline Bi-LSTM model, the model improved macro-average F1-score by 2.2 percent.
The paragraph-level model achieved F1-score improvements of 6 points on Comparison and 7 points on Temporal relations.
The full model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-score for implicit relations.
